title: Streaming long-form media inspection
implemented: Confined chunked immutable snapshots, actual full RGB decoding and timestamp coverage, continuous chunk-boundary comparisons, whole/segment hashes and sampled PNG export.
remaining: Long-form diagnostics cover the declared two-minute 1080p SDR profile, not every production codec, HDR, 4K or arbitrary-duration workload.
Logical pixel buffers are bounded; aggregate decoder/process/container/GPU resource enforcement and operational isolation remain open.
